reviews.review:
Got hit with the ol' bait and switcheroo with this one. lol. I bought the game, hesitated for a bit whether I should keep it, breached the 2 hour mark, only to find out the next day from Wylderzone's youtube account that they will abandon this game to work on a new IP called Dam It. It's funny how they timed a sale before making that announcement. It's like that's their last hurrah before finally abandoning the game. I could've bought Mycopunk instead. Instead, I'm stuck with this abandoned game. Great. Thanks, devs! 

Edit: Do yourselves a favor and not support these devs ever again. They have a history of just straight up abandoning their games after 1.0 release, making buyers like us feel like doofuses.
reviews.developer_response:
Hi !

Sales were planned months in advance and automated on the Steam back end so it definitely wasn't set up as some kind of last hurrah. Regarding other games - we worked on Hunters for close to 2 years solid so are just taking a bit of a break to have a bit of fun and explore new ideas. Nothing is set in stone yet!
